# UiAvatarGroup

A row of overlapping avatars from a typed array, with a counter for the remainder.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | display |
| Import | `import { UiAvatarGroup } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiAvatarGroup from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiAvatarGroup'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/display/UiAvatarGroup.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/display/UiAvatarGroup.vue) |
| Generic | `T extends UiAvatarGroupItem` |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` **(required)** | `readonly TItem[]` |  |  |
| `max` | `number` | `4` | Maximum avatars shown before the remainder collapses into a counter. |
| `size` | `UiSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Collaborators". |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `avatar` | `props: { item: T; index: number }` | Replace one avatar. |

## Attributes

The `<ul>` element.

## Accessibility

- A list (`<ul>`/`<li>`), optionally named with `label`.
- The "+N" counter has a translated text alternative.

## Styling

- `.vui-avatar-group`, `.vui-avatar-group__item`, `.vui-avatar-group__more`
- `--vui-on-surface` (ring colour)

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<UiAvatarGroup :items="team" :max="4" :label="t('demo.team')" />
```
